name: Team Squirtle: Intimidate Pressure & Normal Demolition
archetype: Intimidate attack reduction, Fighting wallbreaking, and special psychic pressure.
gym_duel_rationale: Whitney's 5v5 Gym battle prompts the player to select 5 active team members: Arbok/Primeape acts as the primary frontline breaker, cutting Whitney's Attack on entry with Intimidate and crushing Normal defenses with STAB Close Combat; Blastoise/Fearow brings Ground immunity and heavy Water STAB with Hydro Pump; Alakazam/Weezing bypasses high physical Defense using STAB Psychic and Calm Mind; Jolteon/Sandslash applies paralyzing Discharge speed control; and Snorlax anchors the battle with colossal HP and Rest longevity.

roster.progression_notes: 486 BST starter hybrid. Ground immunity and STAB Hydro Pump exert enormous offensive pressure. Roost keeps it healthy against heavy normal hits.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Levitate grants Ground immunity, while Calm Mind-boosted Psychic melts bulky Normal targets.
486 BST speed sweeper. Volt Absorb absorbs Electric moves. Discharge paralyzes speedy threats like Aipom/Tauros to seize turn momentum.
479 BST Intimidate bruiser. Intimidate neutralizes Whitney's physical Attack on entry. STAB Close Combat delivers devastating super-effective hits.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Absorbs stray Metronomes and Hyper Beams comfortably, resetting any damage or status with Rest and Sleep Talk.
535 BST Water/Ice wall. Shrugs off Water attacks with Water Absorb and provides consistent bulky support across Route 34 and Goldenrod.

flex_bench.rationale: High-durability Grass/Poison tank packing Leech Seed and Sleep Powder for status control.
Intimidate physical pivot and Dragon Dance sweeper with Aqua Tail.
Technician-boosted Triple Kick and Rapid Spin hazard removal for tactical versatility.
